entities.summary: Czesław Dźwigaj is a Polish artist, sculptor, and professor. Creator of numerous monuments, he is most often associated with monuments of Pope John Paul II, almost 50 of which have left his workshop. Czesław Dźwigaj was a painters & sculptors from Nowy Wiśnicz (b. 1950-06-18, Nowy Wiśnicz). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
